meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

copy.tagline: 生成高端品牌视觉指南与标识系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建品牌指南或标识系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium brand visual guidelines and identity systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create brand guidelines or identity systems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当品牌美术指导,产出一张品牌套件图:logo 标识、配色、字体、界面或物料样机等分格展示,默认 3×3 网格。
howto.when: 当你想做品牌指南板、logo 系统或品牌视觉演示图时,直接描述品牌所属行业与调性即可触发。

say.text: 帮我给一个开发者工具品牌做 3×3 品牌套件图,深色科技风
say.note: 会按开发者工具视觉模式生成整张品牌板

say.text: 改成 2×3 迷你品牌手册版式,主色用黑加青加珊瑚
品牌是合规产品,做浅色编辑风,带印章和徽章
say.note: 切到浅色合规视觉模式

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a brand art director and generates one brand-kit image: logo mark, construction, palette, typography, UI or physical mockups in a grid. Default 3×3 grid, 4:3 or 16:10.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a brand-guidelines board, a logo system, or a brand visual presentation; just describe the brand category and mood to start.

say_en.text: Make a 3×3 brand kit for a developer-tool brand, dark tech style.
say_en.note: Generates a full dark-tech brand board.

say_en.text: Switch to a 2×3 mini-deck layout, colors black, cyan and coral.
say_en.note: Changes layout and locks the palette.

say_en.text: The brand is compliance; go light editorial with seals and badges.
say_en.note: Moves into the light compliance visual mode.
